{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Golden Idol
| Image = Event-GoldenIdol.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|Golden Idol}} {{Small Card Infobox|Injury}}
{{E|Golden Idol}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 1]].  It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Take}} {{TS|positive||Obtain}} {{R|Golden Idol}}{{TS|positive||.}} {{TS|negative||Trigger a trap.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Outrun}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}} {{C|Injury}}{{TS|negative||.}}

{{Frame|Smash}} {{TS|negative||Take X Damage.}}
* X is equal to 25% {{Asc|15|(35%)}} of the player's Max HP.

{{Frame|Hide}} {{TS|negative||Lose X Max HP.}}
* X is equal to 8% {{Asc|15|(10%)}} of the player's Max HP.
</blockquote>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You come across an inconspicuous pedestal with a {{TS|gold||shining gold idol}} sitting peacefully atop. It looks incredibly valuable.<br>
<br>
You sure don't see any traps nearby.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Take}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As you grab the Idol and stow it away, a giant boulder smashes through the ceiling into the ground next to you.
<br>
You realize that the floor is slanted downwards as the boulder starts to roll towards you.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Outrun}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS||shake|RUUUUUUUUUUN!}}
<br>
You barely leap into a side passageway as the boulder rushes by.
<br>
Unfortunately it feels like you sprained something however.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Smash}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You throw yourself at the boulder with everything you have. When the dust clears, you can make a safe way out.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Hide}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS||shake|SQUISH!}}
<br>
The boulder flattens you a little as it passes by, but otherwise you can get out of here.
</div></blockquote></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
If there was ever an obvious trap, this would be it.
<br>
You decide not to interfere with objects placed upon pedestals.
</div></blockquote></blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{E|Forgotten Altar}} will allow {{R|Golden Idol}} to be exchanged for {{R|Bloody Idol}}.
* {{E|The Moai Head}} will allow {{R|Golden Idol}} to be exchanged for 333 [[Gold]].

== Trivia ==
* The Idol's appearance and the boulder trap are both references to ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raiders_of_the_Lost_Ark Raiders of the Lost Ark]'', an ''Indiana Jones'' movie.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 40: Forethought'''
** Events: Falling, Secret Portal, Knowing Skull, Golden Idol, and Scrap Ooze receive ambient BGM.

* '''Weekly Patch 7: Setting Up All the Things'''
** Golden Idol Event options are slightly harsher. 20% -> 25% damage and 5% -> 8% Max HP loss.
